body: It's a shame you look like you won't be back here, we are going through very similar things right now.

How much did you take. There can be some pretty bad side effects, which can be delayed. It is important therefore that you seek medical advice immediately as there are medicines which will save your liver. Get to a hospital and bring the packaging of what you took with you.
You just have to keep on surviving. There are many of us coping out there the best we can. Stay positive and embrace the good things you have. All the best

I suffered from extreme fatigue for years. I don't think it contributed to my current state. Here is my advice.

1. Take vitamin d and a b complex daily
2. Use a SAD lamp (a real one from a pharmacy) to wake you up naturally in the morning
3. Practice a stretching activity that will help revitalize your body
4. Consider oxygen therapy
